newsitem.title: UK: Development Securities sells London property.
newsitem.headline: Development Securities sells London property.

text.p: Development Securities Plc said on Friday it had sold the freehold interest of a London property for about 10.1 million stg.
The property investor said it sold Warwick House on Great Pulteney Street to Coronation Ltd.
The 33,300 square foot property is let to British Telecommunications Plc and currently produces a rent of 850,000 stg per annum, representing a net initial yield of 8.2 percent, the company said.
"The disposal reduces our gearing by nearly 15 percent and creates further capacity for those future investment opportunities which we are currently pursuing," the company said in a statement.
